title: 6 Hybrid Pickups Taking Over in 2027 (Who Is Really Winning)
description:
Ford sold seventy-four thousand, three hundred hybrid Mavericks in nine months. That is more than five times what the Hyundai Santa Cruz sold in the same nine months. Meanwhile, two of Detroit's biggest electric truck plans were rewritten around a gas engine, and a third is rumored. The pickup truck is going hybrid, and the numbers show who is winning. Here is the real story of the hybrid truck rush.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:02 1. Ford Maverick Hybrid
4:10 2. Ford F-150 Hybrid
5:42 3. Toyota Tacoma Hybrid
7:18 4. Ram 1500 REV
8:23 5. The next Ford Lightning
9:16 6. General Motors
13:41 The verdict
19:32 What to check before you buy in 2027

Sources:
So today we look at six hybrid trucks and hybrid plans, and there is a twist in every one of them. One hybrid outsold its own gas version. One hybrid truck grew four hundred percent in a single year. One plan was rewritten after a cancelled electric truck. And one is only a rumor, and we will say so clearly. Every number comes from a published source, and the sources are listed in the description.
